faq.q: What kinds of homes does Niwa have?
faq.a: Studios, one bedrooms and two bedrooms across floors two through eight, in nineteen distinct layouts. Studios run 349 to 388 square feet, one bedrooms 703 to 717, and two bedrooms 661 to 745. Each home type under The homes opens a full description and a 3D walkthrough.

faq.q: What does a home cost, and what is available right now?
faq.a: Rent varies by layout, floor and move-in date. The availability map shows every home currently listed with its actual rent and date, refreshed from the leasing system, and each home type lists its starting rent.

Some homes are ready now and others open up over the coming weeks. Every home on the availability map carries its own date, and each home type shows how many are available now and how many are coming soon.

Yes, up to two pets per home. There is a $500 refundable pet deposit and $50 per month, both charged per pet. Cats have a 20 lb weight limit. Dogs have a 75 lb limit, and two dogs must not exceed 75 lb combined. Dogs are interviewed, and some breeds are restricted. Ask the leasing team for the current list. There is a pet washing station in the building.

In-unit washer and dryer, and a stainless steel refrigerator, dishwasher, microwave, range and oven. Vinyl flooring throughout and high-speed internet access. Select homes add kitchen islands, vaulted ceilings, panoramic city views and balcony decks.

faq.q: What does income-restricted (MFTE) mean on a listing?
faq.a: Niwa takes part in Seattle's MFTE and MHA programs, which set aside homes at reduced rent for households under a defined income limit. Participating homes are marked on their listing, and ADA homes are available too. Limits are set by the City and change from year to year, so ask the leasing team for current figures and what you would need to apply.

A rooftop clubroom and outdoor terrace with a grill and seating, looking out over Lake Union and downtown Seattle. A fitness center with cardio machines, weights and equipment, open 24 hours along with the rest of the building's amenities. Package service, extra storage for rent, bike storage, a pet washing station, elevator access to every floor, controlled key fob entry and an on-site manager.

faq.q: Where is Niwa, and what is nearby?
faq.a: 513 1st Ave N in Lower Queen Anne, within walking distance of Seattle Center and the Space Needle, and a short walk from the shops and restaurants along Queen Anne Avenue.

faq.q: How do I see a home in person?
faq.a: Three ways. Tour any layout in 3D from The homes, where the studio, one bedroom (furnished or unfurnished) and two bedroom are all filmed end to end. Tour the rooftop clubroom, rooftop deck and fitness center from The building. Then, when you want to stand in one, send a tour request and the leasing team will arrange a time, or call (206) 622-9991 during office hours.
